title: Onboarding
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: A pale introduction displays product-price stickers, then a sequence of colorful motivation pills, a rendered brain, and floating delay timers. A decision comparison uses green feedback, and the final sample shows a personalized green card with a name field. Blue Continue buttons and a top progress bar anchor the flow.
learning_candidate: Explain the behavior change with concrete visual examples and preview personalization on the final object.
